$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Service Momentum brand on this site. See docs/BRAND.md. To rename the product: node scripts/apply-brand.mjs --to "New Name" (logo artwork and the A2P SMS consent wording are never rewritten automatically).

logo.source: Service-Momentum-sm-mark.png (the SM logo used in the video ads)
logo.rules: Use the SM logo as drawn, on its white rounded tile when the background is dark. Do not recolour, stretch or rebuild it. The product name beside it is HTML text.

tagline: Your past customers are calling someone else.
positioningStatement: The done-for-you Command Center for home-service businesses with repeat customers.
supportingStatement: We load your customer book, track every lead by source, and show you who's due for service, with the text already written. Set up and run for you, every month.
audience: Owner-run HVAC, mini-split, heating, plumbing and similar shops running 1 to 5 trucks. Never describe them as small.
notThis: a CRM you have to learn
legalEntityNote: The legal operator. Named only on the Privacy, Terms and SMS Consent pages, in the SMS consent wording registered for A2P, and in the footer fine print.
endpointConfigNote: The lead-form endpoint is NOT mirrored here. js/site-config.js is the single source of truth for formEndpoint and formEndpointMode — two copies drifted once and will again. scripts/validate.mjs fails if this file reintroduces an endpoint field.

theme.$comment: Taken from the Service Momentum video ads (Remotion theme.ts). Mirrored as --sm-* custom properties at the top of styles.css, which is the single source of truth for the site. Change both together.
theme.font: System UI stack (SF Pro on Apple devices), Inter where installed. No web-font download.
theme.retired: The Forge palette (charcoal #171A1F, orange #D9653B, canvas #F4F0E6) and the earlier navy/gold palette are retired. scripts/brand-lib.mjs lists the exact values and scripts/validate.mjs fails if any return to a shipped file.
